products.title: Products
products.empty-body: Register your product or offer so Seenaly can understand your context and guide you from step one — even before connecting your ad account.
products.not-configured: Supabase is not configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to manage products.
products.no-org: You do not belong to any organization yet. Create one in Settings > Organization first.
products.connection-hint: No Meta Ads connection in this organization yet. Connect one in Settings > Connections (optional).
products.error-url: Enter a valid URL (starting with http:// or https://).
products.hint-identity: Start with the basics: what you call this offer.
products.hint-economics: These numbers define what a good result is — above all the maximum acceptable CAC.
products.hint-positioning: What you promise, to whom, and what defuses the objection.
products.hint-funnel: How the sale happens after the click.
products.hint-meta: Optional. You can do this later without losing anything.

home.title: Your growth copilot
home.subtitle: Turn paid traffic data into decisions, creatives and next tests.
home.not-configured: Supabase is not configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
home.no-org: You do not belong to any organization yet. Create one in Settings > Organization first.
home.context-empty-body: Product context is the heart of Seenaly. No ad account and no data needed: just what you sell, to whom, and at what cost.
home.meta-empty-body: Optional. Connecting your account enriches diagnoses with your campaigns' real numbers.
home.diagnosis-body: With your product context and Meta's official documentation, Seenaly points to the most likely bottleneck, the evidence behind it and the next test — always with risk, confidence and a success criterion.
home.diagnosis-needs-product: Register a product to unlock the diagnosis.

creatives.title: Creatives
creatives.not-configured: Supabase is not configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
creatives.no-org: You do not belong to any organization yet. Create one in Settings > Organization first.
creatives.pick-product: Pick a product to register the creative — start from the creatives list.
creatives.no-product-body: Creatives belong to a product. Register your product to start building the tagged library.
creatives.empty-body: Tag every creative by hook, angle and proof — even the planned ones, before they run. That's how Seenaly learns why a creative wins, not just which one did.
creatives.hint-identity: The basics and where it is in testing.
creatives.hint-strategy: The psychological hypothesis: which pain/desire this creative targets, for whom.
creatives.hint-execution: How the piece delivers the strategy — hook, proof, aesthetics.
creatives.hint-result: What this creative taught (feeds the experiment memory).

funnel.title: Funnel
funnel.not-configured: Supabase is not configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
funnel.no-org: You do not belong to any organization yet. Create one in Settings > Organization first.
funnel.pick-product: Pick a product to record the funnel — start from the funnel screen.
funnel.no-product-body: Funnel data belongs to a product. Register your product to start recording your real sales.
funnel.empty-body: This is what Meta can't see: visits, checkout initiated, purchases, refunds. With these numbers Seenaly separates whether you lose people on the page, at checkout, or on the offer.
funnel.hint-period: Which period these numbers cover, and where they came from.
funnel.hint-stages: The count at each stage. Fill in what you have.
funnel.hint-revenue: Gross and net revenue for the period.

experiments.title: Experiments
experiments.not-configured: Supabase is not configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
experiments.no-org: You do not belong to any organization yet. Create one in Settings > Organization first.
experiments.pick-product: Pick a product to register the experiment — start from the experiments list.
experiments.no-product-body: Experiments belong to a product. Register your product to start logging your tests.
experiments.empty-body: Most people run tests and lose the learning. Log every test as hypothesis → result → conclusion — and Seenaly stops repeating what was already disproven.
experiments.hint-hypothesis: What you believe will happen, and why.
experiments.hint-execution: The change made, the period, the budget and the metrics you'll track.
experiments.hint-result: What happened, what you concluded and the next step — that's what becomes reusable knowledge.

diagnosis.title: Diagnosis
diagnosis.not-configured: Supabase is not configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
diagnosis.no-org: You do not belong to any organization yet. Create one in Settings > Organization first.
diagnosis.empty-body: Seenaly will cross {product}'s context with Meta's official documentation — and with your campaign data, if any — to point at the most likely bottleneck and the next test.
diagnosis.no-product-body: A diagnosis starts from product context: without knowing what you sell, at what cost and to whom, any answer would be generic.
diagnosis.insufficient-title: Not enough basis to conclude yet
diagnosis.insufficient-body: Data is missing for a firm conclusion. Treat the recommendation as a hypothesis.

activation.title: Your next steps
activation.description: A few steps to your first diagnosis.
activation.step-depth: Complete the context (promise and target CAC)

connections.title: Connections
connections.not-configured: Supabase is not configured. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to enable connections.
connections.no-org: You do not belong to any organization yet. Create one in Settings > Organization first.
connections.credentials-note: Credentials are validated with the provider and stored server-side only — they never reach the browser.
connections.empty-body: Optional: Seenaly already guides you with no data at all. Connecting your account enriches the diagnoses with your campaigns' real numbers.
connections.no-connectors: No connectors are registered in this project.

billing.checkout-unavailable: Online payment is not available yet — contact support to activate your plan.

organicGrowth.title: Organic Growth
organicGrowth.subtitle: Turn organic content into evidence, commercial signals, and clear next actions.
organicGrowth.not-configured: Supabase is not configured. Add the public Supabase environment variables to use Organic Growth.
organicGrowth.no-org: You do not belong to an organization yet. Create one in Settings before setting up Organic Growth.
organicGrowth.entitlement-title: Add Organic Growth to your workspace
organicGrowth.entitlement-body: Discover which content strengthens your funnel, shows buying intent, and can become a high-performing campaign.
organicGrowth.entitlement-admin-only: An organization owner or admin can add Organic Growth to this workspace.
organicGrowth.activation-body: Activate the module for this workspace, then choose a product and a content source to get the first diagnosis.
organicGrowth.deactivation-confirm-body: Existing content and reviews will be preserved. New syncs and analyses will stop until the module is activated again.
organicGrowth.activation-readonly-body: Your existing history is preserved. Activate the module again to sync content and generate new analyses.
organicGrowth.activation-checklist-title: Your path to the first Growth Review
organicGrowth.activation-checklist-description: Complete the essential steps; a connected social account enriches the analysis, but manual import also works.
organicGrowth.setup-subtitle: A few focused decisions are enough to turn your content into an actionable first analysis.
organicGrowth.setup-step-product-hint: The analysis uses the product, offer, and audience context instead of generic benchmarks.
organicGrowth.setup-step-source-hint: Connect an authorized account or start with CSV or manual entry.
organicGrowth.setup-step-mapping-hint: Tell Seenaly which products each account and content set supports.
organicGrowth.setup-step-goal-hint: Choose the business outcome the content should help move.
organicGrowth.setup-step-context-hint: Review the context that will ground every diagnosis and recommendation.
organicGrowth.setup-step-period-hint: Use a period with enough comparable content to avoid premature conclusions.
organicGrowth.setup-complete-body: We can now import content, review its classification, and prepare your first Growth Review.
organicGrowth.manual-fallback-note: You can start without an approved integration. Imported and manual data are clearly identified in every analysis.
organicGrowth.csv-body: Use the standard template so metrics, dates, classifications, and data origin can be validated before import.
organicGrowth.csv-drop-file: Drop the CSV here, or choose a file
organicGrowth.csv-success-body: {count} contents were imported and are ready for classification review.
organicGrowth.csv-partial-body: {valid} rows were imported and {invalid} need correction.
organicGrowth.csv-error-title: The file could not be imported
organicGrowth.csv-error-body: Check the template and the highlighted rows, then try again.
organicGrowth.manual-body: Record the URL, publication details, and available metrics. The source will be labeled as manual.
organicGrowth.loading-body: We are preparing your workspace and most recent analysis.
organicGrowth.syncing-body: You can leave this page. Imported content and metrics will appear as each batch completes.
organicGrowth.stale-title: The latest data may be outdated
organicGrowth.stale-body: The last valid analysis remains visible. Sync the source before making a new decision.
organicGrowth.error-body: No data was changed. Try again or check the connected source.
organicGrowth.empty-title: Turn your first content into a growth signal
organicGrowth.empty-body: Choose a product and import published content to reveal funnel gaps, buying intent, and paid-media opportunities.
organicGrowth.empty-content-body: Connect Instagram or use the CSV template. A social connection is useful, but it is not required to start.
organicGrowth.empty-review-body: Once content is classified, Seenaly can turn the period into evidence, priorities, and experiments.
organicGrowth.empty-strategy-title: There is not enough classified content yet
organicGrowth.empty-strategy-body: Review the first classifications so funnel coverage and message opportunities can be calculated.
organicGrowth.empty-filter-body: Clear one or more filters to return to the available content.
organicGrowth.insufficient-title: There is not enough data for a reliable conclusion
organicGrowth.insufficient-body: The missing signals are shown below. Collect more comparable content or configure the suggested tracking before changing the strategy.
organicGrowth.partial-data-body: Use this result as a hypothesis. Confidence will improve as the missing sources and events become available.
organicGrowth.content-not-found: Content not found or no longer available to this workspace.
organicGrowth.review-not-found: Growth Review not found or no longer available to this workspace.
organicGrowth.data-quality-subtitle: How much reliable context supports this analysis.
organicGrowth.coverage-subtitle: See where the content strategy supports the buying journey and where it leaves gaps.
organicGrowth.coverage-no-data: No classified content for this stage
organicGrowth.scores-subtitle: Relative indicators based on this account's own history and comparable cohorts.
organicGrowth.score-content-intent-description: Estimated strength of commercial-intent signals in this content.
organicGrowth.score-funnel-coverage-description: How well the current content mix supports the stages needed for conversion.
organicGrowth.score-paid-repurpose-description: Potential for this organic content to become a paid creative hypothesis.
organicGrowth.score-message-opportunity-description: Traction of a message that is still underexplored in the account.
organicGrowth.score-commercial-balance-description: Balance between audience-building content and content that invites commercial action.

marketing.home-meta-description: Seenaly diagnoses your Meta Ads with evidence: it finds the bottleneck in the creative, the funnel or the offer and names the next test. Start free, no account connection.
marketing.hero-title: Stop guessing why your ads don't sell.
marketing.hero-subtitle: Seenaly reads your Meta Ads account, your funnel and your test history and returns an evidence-backed diagnosis: where the bottleneck is, what to do now and how to know it worked.
marketing.logos-label: Teams that run their traffic on Seenaly
marketing.features-subtitle: Every conclusion rests on a campaign data point, something about your product, or a rule from Meta's documentation.
marketing.feature-1-title: Go live in days, not months
marketing.feature-1-description: Sign-in, organizations and roles come wired. Your team starts working on day one instead of waiting on infrastructure.
marketing.feature-2-title: Each client in its own space
marketing.feature-2-description: Data is isolated per organization with row-level security enforced in the database — not just filters in the application.
marketing.feature-3-description: Subscriptions, credit packs, coupons and trials. Stripe and Asaas sit behind one interface, so switching costs nothing.
marketing.feature-4-title: Pass audits without preparing for them
marketing.feature-4-description: Append-only event trail, versioned records and consent tracking are always on — the evidence exists before anyone asks.
marketing.feature-5-description: AI answers grounded in your own documents and knowledge base, with usage billed per message through credits.
marketing.feature-6-description: Dashboards and reports read real product data, scoped by organization and role — no exports, no stale spreadsheets.

marketing.testimonial-1-quote: I found my bottleneck was the checkout, not the creative. I cut CPA by 34% fixing the page, not the ad.
marketing.testimonial-2-quote: I stopped swapping creatives on a hunch. Seenaly flags fatigue at the turn and says which to refresh first.
marketing.testimonial-3-quote: The experiment memory is what keeps me: it never re-suggests a test that already failed.

marketing.faq-1-question: Do I need to connect my Meta account?
marketing.faq-1-answer: No. Seenaly starts from your product context and Meta's official knowledge — you can get guidance with no campaign connected. Connecting only enriches the diagnosis once you have data.
marketing.faq-2-question: Does Seenaly publish or manage my campaigns?
marketing.faq-2-answer: No. It analyzes, diagnoses and suggests the next test — the decision and the operation stay with you. It's a decision layer, not autopilot.
marketing.faq-3-question: Is it another automation, like Advantage+?
marketing.faq-3-answer: We don't compete with Meta's automation. Seenaly helps you feed it better: creatives, structure, offer and funnel data Meta can't see on its own.
marketing.faq-4-answer: By credits: each diagnosis spends credits. There's a free plan to start and plans with more credits as your operation grows.
marketing.cta-subtitle: Add your product, get the evidence-backed diagnosis and know the next test — before the day is out.
marketing.about-meta-description: Why we turned the 7am account check every media buyer does by hand into software.
marketing.about-subtitle: Seenaly exists because account diagnosis is daily, repetitive and decisive — exactly the kind of work software should do.
marketing.about-story-p1: Every traffic team starts the day the same way: open Ads Manager, scan yesterday's numbers, guess which changes matter. Once the operation grows past a few accounts, that reading gets shallow — and expensive mistakes hide in the campaigns nobody had time to check.
marketing.about-story-p2: Seenaly does that reading completely, every day, on every account. It flags what a senior buyer would flag and explains the reasoning with numbers, so the human hours go into decisions and creatives — the work that actually moves results.
marketing.about-values-title: Three commitments we do not trade
marketing.about-value-1-description: Every recommendation ships with the data that produced it. If we cannot show the why, we do not show the suggestion.
marketing.about-value-2-description: Seenaly analyzes and recommends; it does not touch campaigns. Changes to your account remain yours to make.
marketing.about-value-3-description: Diagnoses are written so a client can read them — no wall of jargon between the data and the decision.

marketing.terms-1-body: By creating an account you agree to these terms. If you use the service on behalf of a company, you confirm you are authorized to accept them for that company. This is placeholder text — replace it with terms reviewed by your legal counsel before launch.
marketing.terms-2-body: You are responsible for the activity in your organization's account and for keeping credentials safe. Usage must comply with applicable law; abuse, unauthorized access attempts and resale without agreement are prohibited.
marketing.terms-3-body: Paid plans renew automatically for the chosen period and can be cancelled at any time from the billing page, keeping access until the end of the paid period. Price changes are announced in advance and never apply retroactively.
marketing.terms-4-body: The service is provided as described, with reasonable commercial efforts to keep it available. Either party may terminate the agreement; on termination you can export your data, and records required by law remain retained as described in the privacy policy.
marketing.privacy-1-body: Account data (name, email), organization data your team enters, and technical logs needed to operate the service. This is placeholder text — replace it with a policy reviewed by your legal counsel (LGPD/GDPR as applicable) before launch.
marketing.privacy-2-body: To provide the service, process payments through our providers, send transactional email and meet legal obligations. We do not sell personal data.
marketing.privacy-3-body: Data is stored with per-organization isolation enforced at the database level, encrypted in transit, with access restricted by role. Audit events are retained append-only.
marketing.privacy-4-body: You can request access, correction, export or deletion of your personal data. Consent records are versioned, and you can review what was accepted and when from your account.
marketing.readout-signal: CPA up 32% — the bottleneck is CPC, not conversion.
marketing.readout-row-3-value: New hook on the top 3 creatives
marketing.pipeline-title: From raw signal to the next action.
marketing.pipeline-1-body: Spend, CTR, frequency, CPA and ROAS by creative and period — respecting the breakdowns the API lets you cross.
marketing.pipeline-2-body: CPA = CPC ÷ post-click conversion. Is the bottleneck before the click (creative, audience) or after (page, offer, checkout)?
marketing.pipeline-3-body: A fixed format, with confidence and a success test. When there isn't enough data, it says so — it never invents a conclusion.
marketing.row-1-title: Every recommendation anchored to your own data.
marketing.row-1-body: “Test new angles” is a banned answer. Seenaly returns diagnosis, evidence, technical basis, action, risk and success test — same format, every time.
marketing.row-2-title: Refresh the creative before you burn budget.
marketing.row-2-body: When CTR drops and frequency climbs, Seenaly marks the turn — and tells you which top creative to refresh first, based on what already worked.
marketing.bento-3-body: Policies, the learning phase, pixel and CAPI, Advantage+ and relevance diagnostics — the technical foundation of every recommendation.
marketing.bento-4-body: Starts from your product context and official knowledge: which event to optimize, how to structure the first campaign, which offer to test. The Meta account is enrichment, not a prerequisite.
marketing.bento-5-body: Meta's official docs and real data outweigh courses and opinions. The decision knows what to lean on — and what not to.
marketing.row-3-bullet-1: Breaks CPA down: CPC × post-click conversion
marketing.row-3-bullet-2: Says whether it's the page, the price or the checkout
marketing.row-3-bullet-3: Asks for the missing data instead of assuming
marketing.row-3-title: Find out whether the bottleneck sits before or after the click.
marketing.row-3-body: Seenaly breaks CPA down into CPC and post-click conversion. If the problem lives on the page, the price or the checkout, it says so — even when the answer is outside Meta.
marketing.memory-title: It remembers every test you have run.
marketing.memory-body: Every hypothesis, change, result and conclusion stays on record. Seenaly will not re-suggest what you already ruled out, and it gets more specific about your products with each test.
marketing.memory-bullet-1: Hypothesis, change, result and conclusion for every test
marketing.memory-bullet-2: Never re-suggests an experiment you already ruled out
marketing.memory-bullet-3: Learns the patterns of your products and offers
marketing.memory-shot-alt: Seenaly experiment memory screen: every test recorded with its hypothesis, change, result and conclusion.
marketing.cookie-consent-description: We use cookies for core functionality (sign-in, preferences) and, with your permission, product analytics to improve the product. You can opt out of analytics — everything else works either way.
